score_scale: 0–5 analysis; null is missing evidence, not zero adoption or poor health. No composite score is calculated.
license_limit: Root license boundaries were inspected. Full selected-directory, extension, transitive dependency and legal use reviews are incomplete.
readme_limit: Some upstream README/license pages were retrieved from web caches; live metadata, indexed commits and explicitly recorded license blobs are separate evidence. No all-files-at-one-release claim.

repositories.license: GPL-2.0; upstream README specifies GPLv2 or later
repositories.what: Discussion, private groups, member chat and knowledge in one community surface.
repositories.integration: Use native groups and APIs; subscription-to-group support is documented in the now-bundled subscription plugin. Validate current core implementation and failure recovery.
repositories.resource: No measured floor; reserve 3 GiB application memory in the non-video planning budget, excluding shared database/cache.
repositories.why: Beats NodeBB, Flarum and HumHub provisionally on documented subscription-to-group continuity and discussion/knowledge fit, not on measured retention.
repositories.license_scope: Root license inspected; plugins, themes and dependency notices remain a release-specific audit.

repositories.license: MIT community code; enterprise/ separately licensed; third-party notices retained
repositories.what: Staff-facing conversation inbox with contacts, labels, notes and channel routing.
repositories.integration: Link conversation/contact IDs to Member and Interaction; never let an inbox label become entitlement authority.
repositories.resource: No measured floor; reserve 3 GiB application/worker memory, excluding database/cache.
repositories.why: Complements rather than replaces Discourse member chat; inherited Foundry support boundary fits the intake wedge.
repositories.license_scope: Actual root LICENSE read; enterprise feature and channel entitlements not fully audited.

repositories.license: MSCL-1.0-GPL, current source-available terms; future GPL-3.0 grant per version after four years
repositories.what: Permissioned operations records and admin/API interface around the six-object spine.
repositories.integration: Own cross-system mapping and approval evidence, not card credentials, forum content or legal accounting authority.
repositories.resource: No measured floor; reserve 1 GiB application memory excluding database.
repositories.why: Carries forward Foundry rather than inventing a new admin framework; not proven superior to unexamined alternatives.
repositories.license_scope: Actual current license read. Competing-use and protected-feature terms require use-specific clearance; not an automatic technical rejection.

repositories.license: MIT community; packages/ee and packages/server/api/src/app/ee separately governed
repositories.what: Optional versioned workflows for allowlisted routing, review tasks and notifications.
repositories.integration: Use approval records, deduplication and retries. No autonomous refunds, access decisions, publication or unrestricted external sends.
repositories.resource: No measured floor; reserve 1.5 GiB application/worker memory excluding shared database/cache.
repositories.why: Reuse the inherited connector/approval approach; omit when native community automation covers the workflow.
repositories.license_scope: Actual root LICENSE read; selected pieces and enterprise-only functions require release-specific audit.

repositories.what: Client-hosted newsletters and membership digests using a PostgreSQL-backed single binary.
repositories.integration: Maintain consent, suppression and audience-purpose mappings; an active paid membership is not blanket marketing consent.
repositories.resource: No measured floor; reserve 0.5 GiB application memory excluding PostgreSQL. SMTP delivery remains an external cost.
repositories.why: Fits a digest/newsletter requirement without a second CRM; marketing-journey breadth not established.
repositories.license_scope: Actual AGPLv3 root file read; notices and distribution/service obligations require deployment review.

repositories.what: Forum, realtime notifications and documented REST read/write interface.
repositories.integration: Map forum user IDs and groups; paid-member lifecycle and plugin compatibility need separate proof.
repositories.resource: No measured floor; Node and chosen supported database add a distinct operational stack.
repositories.why: Strong community alternative; no matched subscription reconciliation audit completed, so no final rejection.
repositories.license_scope: Actual GPLv3 root license read; installed plugins/dependencies not audited.

repositories.license: AGPL-3.0-or-later or proprietary under dual licensing
repositories.what: Member profiles, spaces, content and modules for a social-network-shaped community.
repositories.integration: Space membership resembles entitlement; API, SSO and selected module licensing must be checked individually.
repositories.resource: No measured floor; PHP/database and module workload require separate testing.
repositories.why: Potentially better social-directory fit than a forum, but payment/access module boundaries are unresolved.
repositories.license_scope: Actual dual-license notice read; referenced AGPL file, proprietary modules and release notices require full audit.

repositories.what: Extensible PHP discussion core; installation uses the separate skeleton workflow.
repositories.integration: Extensions provide integration surface; complete billing/moderation/export assembly not evaluated.
repositories.resource: No measured floor; upstream simplicity is a claim, not measured whole-stack resource savings.
repositories.why: Useful lighter-core comparator; community payment and operational parity have not been established.
repositories.license_scope: Actual LICENSE.md inspected. Each selected extension and installer dependency needs its own review.

repositories.license: GPL-2.0; PMPro/Paid Memberships Pro trademarks separately controlled
repositories.what: WordPress membership levels, recurring gateway integration and member import/export.
repositories.integration: Maps levels and orders to membership; not a standalone peer-community platform.
repositories.resource: No standalone floor: requires WordPress/PHP/database and whichever community plugins are selected.
repositories.why: Strong alternate assembly when the client already owns a WordPress membership site; not added on top of Discourse.
repositories.license_scope: Actual license.txt read. Trademark and modified-distribution/updater notices remain explicit; addons audited separately.

repositories.what: Self-hostable live calls with browser clients, SDKs, screensharing and moderator-facing controls.
repositories.integration: Private-room authorization must follow event membership; do not use a public meeting service as the self-hosted design.
repositories.resource: Unmeasured and potentially decisive: simultaneous video, bandwidth and recording cannot be inferred from a 16-GiB non-video budget.
repositories.why: Candidate for the hard self-hosted live-call requirement, but not admitted until co-hosting and room-access tests pass.
repositories.license_scope: Actual Apache2 root file read; Docker/component/dependency and recording paths require separate release audit.
